metadata.resource_scope: application process tree; CPU percent is one-core normalized

limitations: requestAnimationFrame is a presentation proxy, not a GPU fence.
GPU utilization, GPU memory and private memory unavailable; null is not zero.
Display refresh rate must be recorded from the actual display settings.
Cold startup is not instrumented in this baseline.

Mixer timing covers animation sampling and local transform writes. Bone/world matrix updates are included in render submission and not separately timed. Parse includes texture decode; GPU upload is included in first render CPU submission. Skinning runs on GPU and is not separately timed. TTFM/TTFA use render submission plus the next animation callback.
Stress asset transport is shared loopback HTTP; asset-server CPU/RSS is outside application process scope.

assetMetadata.name: mega-2_1gb-geometry-heavy
assetMetadata.texture_codec: PNG RGBA8 / DEFLATE stored (no entropy compression)
assetMetadata.generated_from: procedural skinned cylinder meshes / animated hierarchy / morph / PBR maps
notes: 2.1 GB means 2,100,000,000 decimal bytes; actual file is within 1024 bytes above target.
All images and morph targets are referenced by visible scene meshes; all joints belong to the animated hierarchy.
Geometry uses interleaved POSITION/NORMAL/UV/JOINTS/WEIGHTS plus TANGENT at 72 bytes per vertex.
Mandatory 4-byte GLB alignment only; no size padding.
GPU estimate includes a full mip chain, excludes geometry/render targets/driver overhead.
assetMetadata.integrity_method: SHA-256 computed during generation and independently streamed verification; renderer checks length without rehashing multi-GB bytes
assetMetadata.transport: loopback HTTP; Cache-Control no-store; OS file cache uncontrolled
